en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad urban square with a central circular fountain and surrounding streets. Early automobiles, carriages, and a tram or bus travel around the square. Multi‑story European‑style buildings frame the scene, including a prominent classical building in the center background. The card bears postal cancellation lines and stamps over the image, and printed caption text at the bottom reads that it shows Cairo's Opera Square.
